## Tibbles

```{r tibble-intro}
# Print the penguins tibble
penguins
```

**Question:** How many rows and columns does `penguins` have? What types are the columns?

*Your answer here:*

```{r tibble-indexing}
# [ ] returns a tibble
penguins[1:3, "species"]

# [[ ]] returns a vector
penguins[["species"]] |> head(10)

# $ returns a vector
penguins$species |> head(10)
```

## The Pipe and Tidyverse Verbs

```{r pipe-demo}
# Base R vs tidyverse — same result, different readability
# Base R:
penguins[penguins$species == "Adelie", c("species", "bill_length_mm")]

# Tidyverse:
penguins %>%
  filter(species == "Adelie") %>%
  select(species, bill_length_mm)
```

---

## select() and filter()

```{r select-demo}
# Keep only a few columns
penguins %>%
  select(species, island, bill_length_mm)
```

```{r filter-demo}
# Keep only Gentoo penguins
penguins %>%
  filter(species == "Gentoo")
```

```{r filter-combined}
# Combine conditions: Chinstrap penguins with bill > 47mm
penguins %>%
  filter(species == "Chinstrap" & bill_length_mm > 47) %>%
  select(species, bill_length_mm, sex)
```

## mutate()

```{r mutate-demo}
# Add a bill length in cm column
penguins %>%
  mutate(bill_length_cm = bill_length_mm / 10) %>%
  select(species, bill_length_mm, bill_length_cm) %>%
  head(5)
```

## group_by() and summarize()

```{r summarize-demo}
# Summary statistics per species
penguins %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarize(
    count           = n(),
    mean_bill_mm    = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mass_g     = mean(body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Joins

```{r join-demo}
# Two small tibbles to join
island_info <- tibble(
  island = c("Torgersen", "Biscoe", "Dream"),
  region = c("Antarctic Peninsula", "Palmer Archipelago", "Palmer Archipelago")
)

# Left join — keeps all rows from penguins
joined <- penguins %>%
  left_join(island_info, by = "island")

nrow(penguins)    # rows before
nrow(joined)      # rows after — should be the same
```
